S.FORM: == Taypak 101 miawas tu mihcaan miuing tu siwacahay a panpawa == Taypak 101 miawas tu mihcaan siwacahay a panpawa amiuing , "Taipei 101 NewYear Firework", u Taywan Taypak-se a Taypak 101 matatundyhan a luma' namaka 2003 mihcaan, patucek han tu mihcaan tu 12 bulad 31 demiad " miawas tu mihcaan" katukuh tu cila a mihcaan tu 1 bulad 1 demiad " sayaway nu mihcaan" pisulitan nu tukian a patahekal tu silamalay nu panpawa, u piawasan nu Taypak a labui nu nipiuingan nu Taypak salimulakay nu baluhay a mihcaan. :Taipei 101 NewYear Firework) High新年城之壓軸. picidekan u sayaway nu kitakid a nipatideng i matatunduhay nu luma'an a patahekal tu silamalay nu panpawaan. nipikilukan sayaway aitida i matatunduhay a luma'an apakasilamalay tu panpawaan, satalakaway a nipadeng makaala tu 509.2 kunce "1,671 ince", itida i madicemay nu nikatatungduhan, u satalakaway nu kitakid a nipalamalan tu panpawaan, itida i 2015 mihcaan katukuh tu 2016 mihcaan a miuing sa u nipalamalan tu panpawa makaalatu 30,000 a lalacuan, sakaytini i kitakid nu matatungduhay nu laumaan u satalakaway nu kilukan. nikalingatuan, tu mihmihcaan makaala tu lasubu nu wang ku tademaw mutaydaay a miadih, malakitakid atu Taywan sakatinengan nu tataydaan tu miawas nu mihcaan a kawawan. . nipaadih a kawaw 表演流程 tu mihmihcaan a nipaadih a kawaw, namakayda namin tu tuki nu Taypak " CTC+8" 12 bulad 31 demiad tu labii malingatu, Taypak 101 a matatunduhay a luma' nu hekal a cabeng, kanca makayda ku nikatahekalan a paadih, katukuh tu miawas tu mihcaan a misausi tu tuki sa hamawsa a mapaneng, micumud tu sadikuday a sulitan nu tuki, tu mihmihcaan caay namin kalecad i waluay a nikatatungduhan nu luma ku cacay a sasulitan sipakay hekal namaka sasa tapabawsa, misamelimelitan mapaneng itidatu a sakalimulakan, palecad makayda i nikudan ku nipiasipan tu cacay a bataan, katukuh tu sadikuday nu Taypak a tuki tu cacay bulad cacay demiad sep benis sep selic milawit tu baluhay a mihcaan tatengan a malingatu, tawya nikatatungduhan nu hekalan paadih tu silamalay , misatanayu' tu tukian. (UTC+8)12月31 . mangaleb i Taypek sayaway u kunfan ku mikawaway a " miawas tu mihcaan a paimung" sa, palekal tu pilawitan nu mihcaan a paimung. namaka tawya nu kitakidan a saayaway ni patideng tu talakaway nu matatungduhay a luma'an - Taypak 101, mala miawasay tu mihcaan a tataydaan. yu miasip tu namaka nikudan a miasip sa. mahedek tu a namaka nikudan miasip satu, papangpawa tu siwacahay i hekal nu matatungduhay a lumaan " saan tu picapian a mahedek tu 2003 katukuh i 2004 mihcaan tu sipakayda i nikudan miasip tu sapiawas tu mihcaan, itida a cacay i Taypak 101 liklik a papanpawan tu silamalay. nika itini i 2003 mihcaan tu nu ayawan, Taypei-se u se-cen-hu nu ayawan a putahan ku sakasikawaw tu piawasan nu mihcaan a angangangan nu kitidaan. . tu mihmihcaan a kawaw 歷年活動 2003 mihcaan 12 bulad 31 demiad ~ 2004 mihcaan 1 bulad 1 demiad 2003年12月31 2020年1月1日 Taypak salimulakay nu baluhay mihcaan-2020 pilakuuytan nu limulakay a labii u " satabakiay kaku a TAIPEI X TAIPEI", u " lamel" ku sakay balucu', patahekal tu Taypak a nikayadahan tu malamelay nu picidekan, mikakatu naayaway tu mudadiway a aadihan, milakuuyt tu sakakaput atu caayay kalecad nu nidatengan crossover saan tu nikalamelan tu angangangan nu lalangawan. 臺北最High新年城-2020 TAIPEI X TAIPEI",以"混" crossover . ina yen-huo-siw u Taywan musaungayay a kusi " Taywan pa" ku sikawaway, ngangan u " kangalayan a likant-Taywan", mihida Taywan sibalungaay a laheci sa, saan ku imi mangalay ina Taywan idaw ku laheci nu balungaan, yadah ku nitupin tu tuudan nu lalangawan atu nikasilaculan a tuudan, masacacay namin ku balucu' nu tademaw. tanayu' nu panpawaan nu silamalay makaala tu 300 sasulitan, malecad atu nacilaan a mihcaan, u nipatahekalan tu sipanpawaay a lamalay makaala tu 1 wan 6 malebut nu pinaan. tawyaay a nipisikian milawitu cacayay a husuan mitiyang, patahekal tu nipsumadan nu luluay a kulitan, nu cacayay a husuan tusa ku wayway atu tuluay nu kulitan, atu sakalecad nu T-Pad mutiyungay a kulitan u " Taywa pa" masakaputay ku mikawaway. hamaw sa tapabaw ku likat hida satu a misausi tu sipakayda i nikuda miasip, katukuh tu nai' ku aasipen sa malikat namin ku cabeng nu hekal, masadicemay nu likat a dinkian mahida u kamakamaan ku kulitan, udip nu dinkin kalalawlawan salengacay a kulitan, saan tu nipisausi tu tademawan hakiya makaala tu 16 wan a tademaw ku milabuay. tu mihmihcaan paadih tu silamalay nu panpawa kanca idaw ku cacay a bataan nu wan a tademaw tayda i Taypak 101 miadih tu silamalay nu panpawa, sakacaay kacacelcel, balihenaw, hatidaay nu tilibian a tademaw atu wanglu saan musakamu tu caayay kalecad nu aadihan sakacaay kacacelcel sa, duma satu Taywan kasienawan hina hetik ku wal amis puu' nu balian, matalaw tada siwacah tu, hatidaay nu tademawan mikilimaca tu Taypak 101 wali amisan, mahida u Taypak se-cen-hu kitidaan kapah adihan ku sipanpawaay silamalay nu kitidaan, namahida, taneng tayda i micapiay a buyu'an, mahida u Sin-buyu' talakaw ku kitidaan atu kapah aadihan a lalabinan nu liwkangan. .
